sections.text_helper: Section 7.1 "ICACHE introduction" in chapter 7 (Instruction cache (ICACHE)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 207.
sections.section_content:
The instruction cache (ICACHE) is implemented on the C-AHB code bus of the
Cortex®-M33 processor to improve performance when fetching instructions and data from
internal and external memories (the latter only on STM32C59x/5A3 devices).
Some specific features, like dual master ports (second master port only on STM32C59x/5A3
devices), hit-under-miss, and critical-word-first refill policy, result in close to zero-wait-state
performance in most use cases.
